description: This file defines types, constants, and request/response structures for the Android Cuttlefish host orchestrator API version 1, including CVD management, build configurations, and artifact bundles.

classes.name: FetchArtifactsRequest
classes.description: Request structure for fetching artifacts, including an optional Android CIBundle.

classes.name: FetchArtifactsResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing the Android CIBundle.

classes.name: AndroidCIBundle
classes.description: Represents a build artifact bundle, including optional build details and type.

classes.name: CreateCVDRequest
classes.description: Request to create a CVD with environment configuration and optional additional instances; supports deprecated fields.

classes.name: CreateCVDResponse
classes.description: Response containing list of created CVDs.

classes.name: AndroidCIBuild
classes.description: Represents a CI build for Android from ci.android.com, with branch, build ID, and target.

classes.name: AndroidCIBuildSource
classes.description: Specifies build source details, including main, kernel, bootloader, and system image builds.

classes.name: BuildSource
classes.description: Contains Android CIBuildSource as the source for CVD artifacts.

classes.name: ListOperationsResponse
classes.description: Response listing ongoing or completed operations.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents an asynchronous operation with name and completion status.

classes.name: CVD
classes.description: Represents a Cuttlefish virtual device with status info, build source, and identifiers.

classes.name: UploadDirectory
classes.description: Represents an upload directory with name.

classes.name: CreateSnapshotResponse
classes.description: Contains the ID of a created snapshot.

classes.name: EmptyResponse
classes.description: An empty response structure used for various API responses.

classes.name: StopCVDResponse
classes.description: Alias for EmptyResponse, indicating response for stopping a CVD.

classes.name: StartCVDRequest
classes.description: Request to start a CVD, optionally from a specific snapshot.

methods.name: ID
methods.description: Method returning the identifier string for a CVD instance.
